summary: The statement and proof are correct. The inverse image of each proper halfspace under the midpoint map is a proper closed halfspace of the full-dimensional product body in dimension 2d containing its centroid, so the gamma_{2d} component bound follows from the accepted metronoid-Grunbaum fact. The centroid-cloud comparison and affine centerpoint step then yield (4)-(5). The harmonic-mean identities and conversions to minimum weights are correct, including the central term and the bounded-ratio factor theta_d(K), and they yield (6)-(10) with the claimed constants and strict inequalities.
